name: @tina/discord-connector
description: The Discord platform connector: ONE persistent Gateway session that joins voice channels on demand, decodes each speaker's Opus stream, and drives the shared gmeet transcript lane. Implements the runtime.v1 workload surface for profile=discord-bot so meeting-api spawns/tears down a voice session exactly like a container.
